candidates.title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Very recent systems work exposing composable CXL memory through Kubernetes DRA for cross-node KV-cache reuse, with vLLM/llm-d integration and a real CXL appliance.
